release.content: publet-algorithms 0.1.0 was released on 2026-10-04 from commit e883eee4181cadc480b99142a2a67bfa1dfabad2 with these changes.

rows: The generic algorithms publet is built on, depending on nothing publet-specific: an RFC 6962 Merkle log with inclusion and consistency proofs and a checkpoint schedule; sorted-set membership with absence proofs; recursive content trees; Fixed6 exact fixed-point arithmetic; deterministic personalized PageRank; graph traversals (reachability, closure, root, topological order); and version arithmetic and requirement matching.
